# Drew

Drew (email `Dherchko@gmail.com`) collaborated with Dan on a green-mapping project at [[wiki/work/nemacolin-caddying|Nemacolin]] over an intense eleven-day stretch in June–July 2017 (`+17244157295`, 45 messages) — almost certainly the caddy yardage books used to help players read the greens. The pair trade sketches and design feedback: green widths and depths at their widest/deepest points, arrows sized to show slope severity, line-boldness calibration so slopes don't visually read as "cliffs," and whether false-front greens need arrow tips dragged forward to represent the effect. They plan to cover the back nine together, referencing "Hazeltine" (a famous, notoriously difficult green complex) as a confusing comparison case. The thread is purely collaborative and enthusiastic ("I'm a fan," "outstanding," "should be awesome") with no personal or transactional content, and ends abruptly July 1, 2017.
